detail.title: Foundations of Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.summary: This revision integrates hierarchy-aware planning (BIHRL) and ensemble-based optimistic value estimation (VBE) to explain how agents might autonomously structure problem-solving strategies. It posits that goal specification arises not merely from external assignment but from the recursive application of preference inference, influenced by instrumental succession.
detail.reason: Updating the notebook to incorporate hierarchical planning and instrumental succession perspectives on agency.
